title: UPS: supporting documents for claims
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. UPS says all claims need supporting documentation, such as an invoice showing the value of lost or damaged merchandise, and asks for specific merchandise descriptions (serial numbers, brand, sizes, colour, quantity). During a damage claim photo documentation will be required, and a physical inspection at a UPS-approved location may be needed. Without enough documentation a claim could be delayed or denied. This fully rendered readback supersedes an earlier same-day readback that showed only the introduction; it describes UPS only, not other carriers.
